market_context: No official MCP marketplace exists. Discovery via GitHub, npm, and developer forums. Payment self-built via API keys + Stripe. Comparable to npm packages and VS Code extensions in early ecosystem.

conversion_funnel.github_stars_to_free_users: 5-10% of stars try the free tier

worst_case.assumptions: 0 stars, no users, no paid conversions. Tool fails to gain traction.
worst_case.implementation_complexity: Medium (build MCP server, integrate Stripe, deploy)

median_case.assumptions: 300 stars total, 15 free users, 0.75 paid users (round to 1). Pricing $20/month per API key. 1 paid user by month 6.

best_case.assumptions: 1,200 stars total, 120 free users, 6 paid users. Pricing $50/month per API key (premium features). Viral growth via GitHub trending.

real_platforms_apis_protocols.payment: Stripe API (self-hosted billing with metered API keys)
real_platforms_apis_protocols.discovery: GitHub (trending repos, npm registry, dev.to posts)
real_platforms_apis_protocols.example_mcp_tool: MCP server for automated code review (e.g., integrate with GitHub Actions via MCP)

recommendation: Build a niche MCP server (e.g., for AI agent data enrichment) with a free tier (rate-limited) and paid tier (unlimited). Expect median revenue of $150/month by month 6. Best case requires active promotion on GitHub, Hacker News, and dev communities.
